claims.text: A stalled ad campaign often reflects a slow follow-up process rather than a failed acquisition channel.
Slow lead response is usually a missing automated system, not a staffing shortage.
Review volume tracks how consistently a business asks for reviews, not just job quality.
Referral programs fail most often because there is no way to track who referred whom.
Service businesses run on four core systems: acquisition, automated follow-up, CRM operations, and retention.
